name: DESI
summary: Large spectroscopic survey studying dark energy and large-scale structure, and probing dark matter through dwarf galaxies and Milky-Way / M31 stellar streams.
detection_principle: Robotic fibers simultaneously obtain spectra of thousands of objects, measuring redshifts and stellar radial velocities; spatial distributions reconstruct gravitational potentials and structure.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: The 2026 announcement states that the original five-year observations are complete, while the extended survey continues.

phases.name: Extended survey
phases.description: Continued expansion of sky coverage and dark-matter-related targets

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
